rationale: Both candidates independently surface the one live ground-truth concern (FLASHINFER_ATTN silently ignoring `quant`) with strong, diff-grounded evidence, and both go well beyond it with the same high-value dtype_vo-silent-no-op bug and the doc-deletion regression. Y edges ahead on precision because several claims are backed by actual executed python snippets showing real output (not just assertions) and its extra findings (ring-SP bypass, output-dtype mismatch) are carefully hedged where unverified rather than overclaimed. Y also wins actionability with a clean Blocking/Should-fix/Nits structure and concrete drop-in code fixes, whereas X's report has garbled, mid-sentence-truncated bullets in its 'additional observations' section and leans on some harder-to-trust claims (specific CI/buildkite line numbers) without similar hedging.
